title: MROUND to a multiple of 3: 7 gives 6, 8 gives 9

source.quote: MROUND rounds up, away from zero, if the remainder of dividing number by the specified multiple is greater than or equal to half the value of multiple .
source.supports: the rule for which multiple is chosen
the example table shows 7 giving 6 with the multiple 3

derivation: 7 / 3 leaves remainder 1, less than half of 3 (1.5), so MROUND rounds down to 6. 8 / 3 leaves remainder 2, more than 1.5, so it rounds up to 9. The return value is a decimal number.
